name: smart-app-react
description: The Wildflower chrome every first-party SMART app boots through: `SmartAppRoot` (the telemetry consent gate around both branches, one QueryClient, the launched/standalone branch latched on mount, the launch-failure banner), `runSmartLaunchEntry` (the whole launch.html entry), `ConnectMenu` (the standalone connect flow: over `fhir-r4-react/smart`'s launch primitives for a SMART app, or through the caller's own sign-in for the Wildflower owner UI), the read-status lines an app's page speaks (`LoadingLine`, `LoadingMoreLine`, `ReadFailureLine`), and the in-app patient choice (`usePatientChoice` over `?patient=`, `PatientPicker` with its "All patients" row, `PatientChoiceLine` with "Change patient"). Built on `fhir-r4-react/smart` for the SMART wiring and `branding-react` for the Wildflower chrome, so neither of those has to know about the other.
